latestVersion.changelog:
Seedance 2.0 surreal video generation skill, initial release.

- Enables creation of surreal, physics-defying short videos using only WeryAI Seedance 2.0.
- Requires Node.js 18+ and WERYAI_API_KEY; models locked to SEEDANCE_2_0.
- Enforces detailed English prompt expansion for memorable, cinematic, and impossible visual effects.
- Supports text-to-video and single image-to-video tasks; output is direct video links.
- Strict workflow and security guidelines ensure API key privacy and model compliance.
